text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] INF-620 detected (kv-cache throttling) — p95 latency spike on /v1/search observed 2025-11-07T03:21Z. Pager routed to SRE oncall. Auto-escalation ran.

maria: oncall here. we saw a sudden uptick in cache misses after a config roll yesterday. rolled back the change at 03:30Z, traffic normalized by 03:38Z. no immediate customer data loss.

kevin: thanks — do we have an initial customer impact estimate? which accounts saw errors?

maria: quick scan: ~4% of requests for batch-ingest customers failed with 502/504 during the spike window (03:21–03:38Z). realtime chat apps experienced latency but not complete failures. notified support and a few enterprise CSMs.

oliver: tagging support playbook link: https://intra.redwood/support/plays/incident-notify (FYI)

maria: filing an incident ticket now. I think we should schedule an after-action review to capture root cause and action items — want to pick a host/facilitator and time. I'm happy to run notes but prefer someone else facilitate.

dan: I can act as session host (facilitator) for the AAR. call it an "after-action session" rather than the usual postmortem to keep tone constructive. available: Tue 2025-11-11 16:00–17:00 UTC or Thu 2025-11-13 15:00–16:00 UTC. which works for folks?

kevin: I'm out Tue (pto). Thu 15:00 UTC works for me.

tara: Thu works. prefer sometime after 14:00 UTC.

sophie: Thu 15:00 UTC = 16:00 CET for me, okay.

maria: Thu 2025-11-13 15:00 UTC it is then. Dan — thanks for hosting. I'll take notes and upload the incident timeline to the doc.

dan: great. I'll create the calendar invite and share the notes template. please add these folks: @kevin, @sophie, @tara, @maria, @oliver. optional: infra and product owners for the affected routes.

oliver: adding action-tracker board link here: https://boards.redwood/incidents/INF-620 (will create cards during the meeting).

maria: preliminary agenda:
- quick timeline (maria)
- mitigation steps (oncall)
- root cause hypothesis (kevin + infra)
- fallout & customer impact (support recap)
- action items & owners (all)

kevin: can we include a short run of the failing config change (diff) in the repo? that will help root cause. putting a pointer here: repo: git.redwood/infra/cache-config commit: `a4f9c3e`

sophie: i'll bring up regression test gaps — I've got a failing test sketch to propose.

maria: assigned initial action owners (pre-AAR):
- A1: upload full request logs slice (maria) — due 2025-11-10 EOD
- A2: export rollout config diff + commit link (kevin) — due 2025-11-10 EOD
- A3: reproduce load pattern in staging (sophie) — ETA 2025-11-12
- A4: notify affected customers with timeline & next steps (oliver/support) — draft by 2025-11-11

tara: I can own the remediation to ensure cache-ttl guardrails are enforced (A5). ETA planning: I'll post a plan by 2025-11-17.

dan: facilitator notes: I'll reserve 60m for the session and call out the goals up front — decide on at most 3 remediation action items, assign clear owners, and set deadlines. we'll record and publish notes to the incident doc.

maria: calendar invite snippet (posted by dan):
```
Summary: INF-620 After-Action Session
When: Thu, 13 Nov 2025 15:00–16:00 UTC
Where: Zoom link: https://meet.redwood/zoom/inf-620-aar
Guests: kevin, sophie, tara, oliver, maria, dan
```

dan: invite sent. please RSVP on the event. if you need another time, post here by EOD 2025-11-09.

kevin: RSVP'd.

oliver: RSVP'd, will bring the support impact summary.

sophie: RSVP tentative — may need to shift 30m earlier, will confirm by EOD.

maria: noted — if we need to shift, dan we'll try to keep within Thu window.

dan: post-session follow-ups: I'll create the remediation board cards and assign due dates during the meeting. maria will be primary notes owner; oliver will own the customer comms card.

maria: thanks all. final ask before the session: if anyone has traces or flamegraphs from the spike, drop them in the incident doc under /artifacts.

incident-bot: Reminder scheduled: INF-620 AAR in 72h (Thu 2025-11-13 15:00 UTC).

dan: closing thread for scheduling. we'll reopen for action tracking after the session. cheers :thumbsup:
